summary: Mustahoshin Hossain Ahamed Afif (M. H. A. Afif) is a results-driven IT professional with proven expertise in software engineering, IoT development, and secure system integration. Backed by over four years of experience across multinational companies and diverse industries, he excels in designing and optimizing embedded systems, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure.

bulletPoints: Spearheaded company growth by handling business operations, managing foreign investors, and collaborating with universities, research organizations, and government entities.
Led the development of smart IoT devices, overseeing both hardware and software teams, ensuring innovation and high-quality technical solutions.
Successfully participated in international accelerator programs and secured several international competition victories and funding.

Managed and maintained company websites using WordPress, PHP, and Elementor, ensuring optimal performance and security. Developed and maintained web applications using Vue JS and Tailwind CSS to enhance user experience.
Developed office management software using technologies including Bootstrap, .NET, Microsoft SQL, and Angular, facilitating smooth operations and collaboration within the company.
Automated tasks for business tools such as HubSpot, MailerLite, Google Forms, and Google Sheets, streamlining workflows and improving efficiency.

projects.title: SystemSage Solutions – Official Website Development
projects.description: This project features a fully custom-built corporate website for SystemSage Solutions, developed using modern web technologies with end-to-end control over branding, hosting, and deployment. It emphasizes responsive design, SEO optimization, and clean UI/UX to showcase IoT and agritech solutions, highlighting skills in full-stack development, web infrastructure, and technical branding.
